title: salvia pratensis var. alba
intro: Salvia pratensis var. alba, commonly known as White Meadowsweet, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is native to Europe and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of White Meadowsweet are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also include salvinol and other terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
